source: Actual Experimental features dialog, read-only DOM current controls and visible help; no toggle changed.

defaultEvidence.interpretation: UI indicates current settings match its default condition; not independently confirmed in fresh browser storage.

ownerRule: Default-enabled experimental capability is required. Default-disabled experiment is optional candidate. A disabled entry/presentation variant does not make its underlying capability optional.
persistenceAdvertised: Applies immediately; saved only in this browser.
